title: supply chain analytics and capacity growth

chunks.text:
break-even analysis
ex. Restaurant expansion
$$\begin{aligned}
Rx &= F + Vx \\
\overline{x} &= \operatorname{BEP}(x) = \frac{F}{R-V} \\
\operatorname{BEP}(\$) &= \operatorname{BEP}(x) \times R
\end{aligned}$$
